label: KOREN/Jetson measurement-conditioned replay; not a new field measurement
notes: One measured Jetson is replicated into eight logical timing profiles; these are not eight measured boards.
The measured Qwen full step is partitioned by an assumed tail fraction. No Jetson SFL backward-only measurement exists in these inputs.
The 4.2 MB payload comes from the KOREN echo workload, not from a measured Qwen split activation.
The network rate is an effective aggregate round-trip payload service parameter derived from common wall intervals, not physical one-way link capacity.
The 0.1 capacity factor is a synthetic sensitivity case; compute/payload are unchanged and no 32-to-8 equivalence is asserted.
Network window 0 and Jetson steps 0-9 calibrate the policy; windows 1-2 and steps 10-29 evaluate it.
